info.title: Shipmozo Shipping API
info.description:
REST API for order fulfillment, courier assignment, tracking, warehouses, NDR, and labels. All responses use `result` (`1` = success, `0` = failure), `message`, and `data`.

**Base URL:** `https://shipping-api.com/app/api/v1` — do not add a trailing slash.

**Auth:** Send `public-key` and `private-key` headers on every protected route, or obtain keys via `POST /login`.

**Rate limits:** Shipmozo returns `x-ratelimit-limit` (500) and `x-ratelimit-remaining` on each response. Quota is **500 requests per 1-minute window** per API key; `remaining` drops with each call and **refreshes when the minute rolls over**.

**Support:** munish@apporio.in

rateLimitHeaders.title: Response headers (from live API / Swagger)
rateLimitHeaders.description: Shipmozo documents rate limits via response headers, not only in PDF copy. Read these on every call:

headers.name: x-ratelimit-limit
headers.meaning: Max requests allowed in the current 1-minute window for your API key

headers.name: x-ratelimit-remaining
headers.meaning: Requests left in the current window — decreases by 1 on each API call you make. You only see a new number on the next HTTP response (the page does not auto-update). After ~60s without traffic, the next call usually shows remaining closer to 500 again (sliding window).

rateLimitHeaders.note: 498 in tutorials means '2 calls used this minute' — not a fixed cap. Use Overview → Check now to read current headers.

errorCodes.typicalMessage: unauthorised user access / Invalid API credentials
errorCodes.when: Wrong, missing, or expired public-key / private-key
errorCodes.action: Re-login via POST /login or paste fresh keys from Panel → Profile

errorCodes.typicalMessage: Invalid username or password (exact text unverified). Unknown email/phone may return "Email or phone number is not registered."
errorCodes.action: Verify panel username/password. Unknown accounts may return the unregistered email/phone message.

errorCodes.when: Unknown order_id on assign, schedule, cancel, or get-detail
errorCodes.action: Push the order first; use Shipmozo internal order_id from push-order response

errorCodes.typicalMessage: The selected warehouse id is invalid.
errorCodes.when: push-order with a warehouse_id that does not belong to the account
errorCodes.action: Call get-warehouses or create-warehouse and use a returned warehouse_id

errorCodes.when: auto-assign-order without panel Settings → Auto Assign configured
errorCodes.action: Enable Auto Assign rules in the Shipmozo panel, or use assign-courier instead

errorCodes.when: Too many calls in the shared 1-minute window
Base URL ends with a trailing slash after /v1
errorCodes.action: Use the base URL without a trailing slash

rateLimitGlobal.source: Observed on shipping-api.com production (Cloudflare); limit=500, remaining decrements per call and refills each minute
